news_en.text: AbdomenNet — a foundation model for acute abdomen diagnosis stratification and triage on non-contrast CT, detecting 11 conditions and raising radiologists' mean AUROC from 0.812 to 0.924 — published in Nature Communications (IF 18.1). Co-first author.

news_cn.text: AbdomenNet —— 面向非增强 CT 急腹症诊断分层与分诊的基础模型，可检测 11 种急腹症并将放射科医生平均 AUROC 从 0.812 提升至 0.924，发表于 Nature Communications（IF 18.1）。共同第一作者。
